cover_letter.greeting: Dear FTI Consulting Power, Renewables & Energy Transition Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Consultant role in the Power, Renewables & Energy Transition practice in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The practice appeals to me because it puts financial modeling to work on real problems for power and renewables companies, which is where I've been pointing my MBA.

In an MBA project I built project- and portfolio-level models for a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, testing capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios. Our recommended phased green loan plus ABS strategy reduced sponsor equity by $11.1M and improved levered IRR from 8.58% to 9.79%. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at Thomson Reuters I ran cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows.

That maps to the core of the role: building models, doing industry and market research, and turning the numbers into clear reports and presentations for clients. My energy finance work so far comes from coursework rather than client engagements, so I'd bring careful modeling and clean sensitivities and learn the advisory side from your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
